newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end slightly up on rebound.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end slightly up on rebound.

text.p: Shanghai B shares closed slightly up on Thursday on a technical rebound after sharp losses on Wednesday, traders said.
The B share index gained 0.121 points or 0.16 percent to 82.918 on volume of 15.1 million shares worth $8.9 million.
The index ended down 2.96 percent on Wednesday with market sentiment hurt by falls on the A share market.

Traders said technical charts showed signs of over-selling after Wednesday's fall which made some investors build positions on Thursday, pushing up the index. But the day's rise did not indicate any change to market fundamentals, they said.
"Despite today's rise, volume was thin with most investors reluctant to build positions," one broker said.

"The market will not perform well in the next few days because investors are uncertain about the short-term market trend," a second broker said. "The index will move in a narrow range around the current level on Friday."

Of 43 B shares, 37 traded on Thursday, with 15 up, nine flat and 13 down. Shanghai Steel Tube Co was the star performer on speculative buying after losing 17 percent in the past two days, rising $0.010 or 7.35 percent to $0.146 on volume of 17,000 shares.
Textile maker Shanghai Worldbest Co was the most actively traded on institutional support buying, ending unchanged at $0.630 on volume of 1.9 million shares.
Shanghai's A share index slipped on weaker sentiment with investors expecting further crackdown measures in the short term, traders said.
The index lost 8.252 points or 0.65 percent to 1,265.838 on volume of 268.5 million shares worth 3.4 billion yuan.
The SSE 30 blue-chip index shed 28.521 points or 0.76 percent to 3,726.64 points. Shanghai Erfangji Co was the worst performer, losing 0.32 yuan or 6.53 percent to 4.58.
